supported_scope.game_line: Project Zomboid Build 42, current supported snapshot

explicit_non_goals.multiplayer: Not supported and not on the roadmap.

risk_tiers.tier_0: Load, parser, shared-hook, event, corruption, or package failures reachable in normal play.
risk_tiers.tier_1: Common supported single-player lifecycle and ordinary trait interaction paths.
risk_tiers.tier_2: Bounded optional or unusual supported scenarios without a path into tier 0 or tier 1.
risk_tiers.tier_3: Exhaustive assurance that remains visible but does not independently define normal-play readiness.
risk_tiers.tier_4: Explicit user-approved non-goal. It is never relabeled proven-correct.

classification_note: Release readiness must remain false until every open obligation has an explicit risk tier or approved non-goal disposition.
